pattern.description: Cropped close-ups of user tweets praising the product hard-cut every 2-3 frames (about 80 ms each), each slightly offset and drifting, until settling on one tweet.
pattern.why_premium: Compresses a wall of real testimonials into half a second on the word 'world-class terminal', conveying volume of love without reading time; tight crops and consistent dark theme keep it cohesive.

build_hint.gsap: Timeline of N tweet layers: for each, tl.set(layer, {autoAlpha: 1}, i * 0.083).set(prev, {autoAlpha: 0}, i * 0.083); add a gentle gsap.fromTo(wrapper, {x: 0, y: 0}, {x: 40, y: -20, ease: 'none', duration: 0.5}) drift; last tweet holds.
build_hint.remotion: Sequence per tweet with durationInFrames 2-3 (at 24 fps), back to back via Series; wrap in an AbsoluteFill translated by interpolate(frame, [0, 12], [0, 40]) linear for drift; final Sequence holds.

notes: Camera verdict pan_right likely reflects position offsets between successive tweet crops rather than a true camera pan. The settled tweet's elements overlap; b02/b03 chosen as the two text regions rather than each OCR line.
